scene mollyharukacafenight1
I wind up making it to the cafe shortly after closing as I got caught up in doing some things I don’t want to tell you about.
You see, I typically show you the most important parts of my day — and those parts almost always revolve around all of the girls I’m trying to have sex with.
But sometimes, other things happen to me behind the scenes that I think it’s best to omit as they would only confuse you.
Am I telling you the truth right now? Perhaps.
But who would be there to fact check me if I wasn’t?
For all you know (And for all anyone else knows) this little monologue might only be a hook meant to reel you in.
You won’t pay attention to me throughout the mundane happenings of my life if I don’t do something to make your heart beat a little faster every now and then, right?
Do you like it when I strip myself of special text?
Do you like it when I make your screen flash?
Do you like it when I lead you into dark rooms with exchange students and award you affection points under the pretense that you will use them to get your dick wet?
Of course you do, because you’re still here.
Now, follow these two out into the night in hopes that it will happen once more.
If it doesn’t, you can always jerk off into a sock.
- One of the narrators, or Sensei, or Selebus, or a bug, or something else, or all of those things, or you.
How does the hook feel nestled in your jaw?
: And that’s the story of when I let fifteen dudes fuck me in one night!
scene mollyharukacafenight2
: I wish I had a penis so could fuck you toooooooo
scene mollyharukacafenight3
scene mollyharukacafenight4
scene mollyharukacafenight1
: And that’s the story of when I solo’ed fifteen group-bosses in one night!
: That’s very nice, Molly. But I would like to go home now.
: Hey. I’m here.
scene mollyharukacafenight5
: Supreme Overlord? When did you come in? Actually, better question- why did you come in? We’re closed. And we’ve been closed for about half an hour.
: Did Molly forget to flip the sign again?
: I probably forgot to flip the sign again. I tend to rush things on Fridays so I can go home and watch anime.
: I didn’t really pay any attention to the sign. I just figured I was allowed in here whenever I want since I basically own the place.
: But...I own the place.
: Yeah, but we’re best friends. Which means I pretty much own the place too.
scene mollyharukacafenight6
: We’re best friends? Since when? I thought Sara was my best friend.
: Oh, okay. I get it, Sir. It’s not like hearin’ firsthand that Haruka means more to you than I do is a slap in the face or anythin’.
: Look, you made Molly pout. Molly never pouts.
: You’re both important to me.
: It’s just that my friendship with Haruka is more important because it brings me one step closer to a lifetime of free coffee. No offense, Molly.
scene mollyharukacafenight7
: See, this is one more reason why my business is succeeding and Sara’s isn’t. I bet you pulled that same trick on her, didn’t you?
: Hey, I pay there sometimes. It’s mostly just because I feel bad, though.
: Unfortunately, Sir, if you’ve come here seeking coffee, I regret to inform you that our stock has been depleted.
: However, I do have a plethora of uneventful side quests I keep stashed in my back pocket for when adventurers like you are looking for something to-
: So, how are things, Haruka?
scene mollyharukacafenight8
: For the love of- why doesn’t anyone ever want my quests?! It’s like the lot of you live your lives without thinking you have a hidden XP meter at the bottom of your HUD! Come on!
: I mean...things are fine. Busy. Which is why I stayed and helped Molly close when I’m normally out of here by now.
: Yeah, I stopped by the other night and this place was packed. And, I know this might be a little hard to believe, but Molly was actually working that night.
scene mollyharukacafenight9
: You were there for that and didn’t even bother saying hello?! Am I just an NPC to you?!
: Weren’t you trying to give me a quest like, thirty seconds ago?
: That-
scene mollyharukacafenight10
: Wait...maybe I am an NPC. That would certainly explain why things progress for everyone else while I’m stuck here with the same habits and search history I’ve had since I was ten.
: I know Molly was working that night. I thought she made a typo when she sent me the numbers after closing. I’m surprised she was able to handle that on her own.
scene mollyharukacafenight11
: Oh, Rin was there to help. I got lucky. There’s no way-
: Put your hands down, Molly.
scene mollyharukacafenight12
: Theres no way I would have been able to handle that crowd on my own.
: Either way, you held down the fort and I’m very proud of you for that.
: Does this mean I’m being promoted to supervisor?
: Absolutely not. But, if you don’t mind waiting an extra few hours to go home and watch anime, I wouldn’t mind buying you dinner to celebrate.
: Buying me dinner? Are you...asking me out on a date?
: Would it count as a date if I invited your teacher as well?
scene mollyharukacafenight13
: No...but it would certainly seem like the beginning to some sort of bonus event where our dynamic as a triad changes forever.
: Molly works hard and I benefit from it? Count me in.
: But I haven’t even said yes. There are three harems and a mech drama waiting for me in my dorm room right now.
: You’re that willing to just walk away from a bonus event?
scene mollyharukacafenight14
: Damn it, Sir! Stop using my words against me! You know bloody well I won’t be able to say no if you put it like that!
: Make the correct choices and you might even unlock a sex scene. That's how those games work, right?
scene mollyharukacafenight15
: Are you legally allowed to say that to me as my boss?
: Say what? I didn’t say anything. That was Sensei.
scene mollyharukacafenight16
: Am I legally allowed to say that as-

: Sir, if there’s anything I’ve learned from my time in dating sims, it’s that teachers can get away with anything. Games would be no fun if they were caught right before any of the CGs were unlocked.
: I picked the wrong profession.
: I think you should agree to this dinner thing, Molly.
: Not just because I want food, but because Haruka seems to be in a type of mood right now that would only boil over into something extremely destructive if you didn’t.
scene mollyharukacafenight17
: I don’t know, Sir. Wouldn’t an NPC like me just be getting in the way of your friendship with the Magistrate of Mammaries? Because it sounds like I’d just be an image variant at the end of the day.
: Oh, stop. If you’re not coming, there’s no point to any of this. I have nothing to reward Sensei for and the best friend thing is only an excuse he came up with for free coffee.
: I don’t know...the mech anime I was talking about left off on a pretty big cliffhanger last week and I don’t want the Kendo Princess accidentally spoiling something for me again...
: Bonus event...
scene mollyharukacafenight18
: Gaaaah, fine! Damn this completionist brain of mine!
: But I swear, if I wind up bein’ forced to hide under the bed while the two of you go at it, I’m never playin’ another visual novel again!
scene black
Reluctant as it may be, Molly agrees to take Haruka up on her dinner offer and the three of us exit the store before heading over to the bus stop.
scene nightsky
After a short drive, we’re dropped off in Haruka’s neighborhood so she won’t have to walk very far after she drinks too much and loses feeling in her legs.
This is never verbalized, but I know it to be true as she has gotten hammered on several occasions now and has consistently been a bad drunk.
In fact, so has Molly.
So either tonight is going to be extremely loud and embarrassing for me-
Or I am going to get tossed into a “special bonus CG” regardless of whether I want to be or not.
scene mollyharukacafenight19
: Um...don’t you think you may have ordered a little too much wine?
: One of the bottles is for later.
: Yeah, who am I kidding? Of course you and Sara are best friends. I’d only get in the way of your soon-to-be liver disease.
scene mollyharukacafenight20
: I’m glad you understand.
: Are you not going to drink, Sir?
: Are you not going to drink, Molly? The waitress didn’t seem to mind that you were underage based on...well, the fact that she offered you a drink as well.
: I’ve decided it’s best for everyone if I just don’t drink anymore.
: You’re stronger than I am, Molly.
: Yeah, that’s probably for the best. I’ll hold off for tonight as well.
: If it’s for my sake, Sir-
: I’ll hold off for tonight as well.
scene mollyharukacafenight21
: Oh...okay.
: Hey now, why the long face? I thought the “emotional climax of Molly MacCormack’s teenage years” or whatever it was you called it earlier had already come to an end.
scene mollyharukacafenight22
: It...It is! And my face is no longer than normal! I just...I remembered a particular scene in a show I’m watching that...evoked the...memory of a debuff I...
: Anyhow, thanks for dinner! Let’s not talk about the previous stages of an NPC’s life!
: How about the future stages then?
scene mollyharukacafenight23
: Why do we have to talk about the NPC at all when you two are clearly the playable characters here?
: Because you’re not an “NPC.” You’re a good girl who’s passionate about her interests and has just fallen on some hard times. That’s all.
scene mollyharukacafenight24
: That...That is perhaps the nicest thing you’ve ever said to me.
: It’s probably the alcohol talking. Or the fact that this actually is a date and I’m just here as her wingman.
: It’s neither of those things. I can be nice sometimes too, you know. If Molly was really a thorn in my side, I wouldn’t let her work for me anymore.
scene mollyharukacafenight25
: I’m genuinely interested in what the next stage of your life will hold. I mean it.
: Just look at that face. She’s hitting on you right now and if you don’t pick up on that, all of those dating games were for nothing.
: The Supreme Overlord makes a valid point. You do look like you’re about ready to pounce on me. But I will give you fair warning, my stamina is far too low to be worth it right now.
: Molly, I’m being serious. I’m rooting for you. It’s about time you got some sort of win in life.
scene mollyharukacafenight26
: This sudden eruption of sentimentality is super effective and I suggest you slow down if you don’t want me fainting at the dinner table.
: Go ahead and faint. Sensei will carry you home.
: Hey, don’t rope me into this. I’m just here to eat and watch you two flirt.
: Why would I be the one to flirt with Molly when you’re obviously next in line for her heart now that Rin’s out of the picture?
: Next in line? There is no queue for my feelings. This isn’t the Sims and I didn’t just go around right clicking on “flirt” with everyone in my line of sight.
: I’m not saying you did. But if you were to pursue romance with anyone right now, who would it be?
: Haruka, you’re making her un-
scene mollyharukacafenight27
: Probably...the Herald of the Adolescents...
: Bingoooo. I know my work-daughters better than anyone.
scene mollyharukacafenight28
: That...uhh...doesn’t mean I’m planning on moving out of the common route or anything, though! I’m just simply stating that there isn’t really anyone else in the make-believe feeling queue!

: And that if this were a game, which it is because everything is a game and that is why life is worth living, you would just so happen to be the closest person I have to...you know...a romance route...
: Molly-
scene mollyharukacafenight29
: You don’t...have to tell me you don’t look at me that way, Sir! I’m already aware! I couldn’t be further away from your type. Just like...
scene mollyharukacafenight30
: Just like...how it was for Rin...
: Look what you did.
: Me? You’re the one who started this. I literally just said I was only here to eat and watch you two flirt.
: Yeah, but if a girl starts getting down on herself in front of you, you’re supposed to say something. Not just sit there and let her fall deeper into the hole she’s digging.
: And you’re not supposed to put people on the spot like that. What did you think was going to happen? That I’d jump over the table and kiss her?
: Weird...the event’s turning sour and we didn’t even have any options to choose from...
scene mollyharukacafenight31
: I’m just saying, that’s how it is for everyone in your class. They all feel that way about you — not just Molly. It’s obvious to anyone that you’d be next in line for her.

: I didn’t mean anything bad by it and I didn’t mean to put either of you on the spot. I just figured it might be a boost in confidence for her to know that the guy she’s interested in is at least somewhat-
: He’s not, though.
scene mollyharukacafenight32
: Why would he be?
: What do you get for falling in love with an NPC? They never change. Their whole purpose in the game is to move the actual players forward.
: Sir is the protagonist and I’m just a stepping stone. All that stuff about me becoming the main heroine is all talk because I know I’m not cut out for it.
: Best chance I have is to wait for a fandisc that makes all the background girls like me more appealing to the masses.
: This is not the direction I was trying to lead this conversation in and I’m really sorry I brought anything up.
scene mollyharukacafenight33
: Don’t worry about it, Magistrate. You’ll not be faulted for lacking clairvoyance. There are some things about me that even you do not understand.
: Let’s just...get back to talking about non-Molly things because Molly-centric things always seem to bring everybody down! But that’s a problem with her, not everyone else.
: It’s not a problem with you.
scene mollyharukacafenight34
: You’re not doing anything wrong. You’ve never been doing anything wrong.
: The game you’re playing is just really hard.
: You’ve got that right, Sir. I haven’t even figured out the controls yet.
: Me neither, and you haven’t been playing even half as long as I have.
: It’s a weird situation when Haruka is the one at the table who has the most of her shit together.
scene mollyharukacafenight35
: Hey! Don’t compliment me and insult me at the same time! I don’t know how to process that!
: Perfection only exists in fan-fiction. And also Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.
: Your flaws make you beautiful, Haruka.
scene mollyharukacafenight36
: And your breasts amplify it.
: Oh, come on...
: I hope to one day be as powerful as you.
: Yeah, we’ll see how you feel about that once the back problems start kicking in...
scene black
Somehow, we manage to avoid further tragedy and carry on with dinner without hurting one another again.
But along the way, I realize just how endangered Molly is.
For while I wasn’t looking, she got my hook caught in her mandible.
And her only options at this point are to either wait for me to free her-
Or to be captured and consumed.
Which would you rather see?
I know the answer.
Because you’re the same as her.
And I love the way you taste.
